note: The recorded floor for judge quality, enforced by `gonogo eval` and therefore by CI. Core checks are invariants that must never fail; these are the aggregate numbers that must never silently drift. Lowering any value here is a deliberate act and belongs in the same commit as the reason, with a line in EVAL_LOG.md — exactly like a prompt change. Raising one after a genuine improvement is encouraged. Values are fractions of runs, matched against the replay set the CI job scores.
